root.label: Greece firefighting helicopters collide, killing two

events.label: Greece firefighting helicopters collide, killing two

slots.name: death toll
slots.sentence: Prime Minister Kyriakos Mitsotakis of Greece said in a social media post that the two men who had died were a Greek coordinator and a Danish pilot.

slots.name: people aboard
slots.sentence: The helicopters were fighting a blaze on Sunday in the Attica and Boeotia regions and carrying two Greek nationals and two foreign nationals, the Hellenic Fire Service said . The men aboard the second helicopter survived, it added.
